mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals persistent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate crossing above 5.0% triggers immediate market repricing of tightening cycles, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 310 signal inflation-fighting monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 310 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, HOUST below 1250 signals weakening consumer housing demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1250 in late-cycle expansion (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A negative quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings forecasts and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is negative (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% and INDPRO < 100 signal labor-market weakness combined with industrial slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% and INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regimes, INDPRO below 100 signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate output expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 in post-pandemic recovery (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).
